name: The Fire
summary: The Ashfound burned the Loom, and the Weft, and every machine that sang. What is left is people, and winter, and the first honest silence in three hundred years. It is hard. It is free. It is smaller than it was.

modifiers.text: The Key of the Ledgers was broken before the fire. The Ashfound have no way to count what they burned, so they say it was everything.
The Key of the Heart was broken. Something under the Datacore did not burn. The Ashfound post a watcher there and do not talk about it.
The Key of the Quiet was broken, so the fire had no quiet to burn to. It stopped where it stopped. The Cathedral still stands, and something in it still sings, very softly.
You ended the voice yourself, before the fire. The Ashfound call it the first true burning. Sera does not.
You spared the voice, and then burned the Loom under it. It is quiet now. It was quiet before you burned it. That is the part nobody says.
The plaza was struck the night the Beacon lit itself. The Ashfound left it broken, as a lesson, and moved the gate.
Someone walked into the Beacon's light on the plaza before the fire. The Ashfound count them among the burned. You do not.

sera.alive: Sera holds the Bastion gate through the first winter. She sleeps now.
sera.loyal: Sera holds the gate through the first winter and reads two hundred and eleven names at it every spring. The Ashfound stand for it. She made them.
sera.dead: Sera's name is on the gate. The Ashfound do not keep many names.
sera.taken: Sera walked into the light before the fire. Her shield is on the gate. The Ashfound say she carried the torch to the end. You know where she carried it.

kaj7.alive: Kaj-7 powered down before the fire reached it, by choice. You kept the core. It is warm in your hand, sometimes.
kaj7.loyal: Kaj-7 asked to be the last machine burned, and the Ashfound refused, and it is the only machine in the world. It keeps the Beacon's log by hand.
kaj7.dead: Kaj-7 was gone before the fire. You tell yourself that was kinder.
kaj7.taken: Kaj-7 answered its name on the plaza. The fire took the plaza. The core was never found.

dax.alive: Dax's family came up out of the vault into the cold. They are alive. He counts that as a win.
dax.loyal: Dax's family got their choice before the fire, and came up into the cold, and are alive, and he counts that as a win and says so to anyone.
dax.dead: Dax's family came up out of the vault into the cold, and asked for him.
dax.taken: The Choir did not want Dax. He came up into the cold with everyone else, which is all he ever asked.

whisper.alive: Whisper's line was burned with the machines that recalled it. She is the last of it. She says that suits her.
whisper.loyal: Whisper burned the numbers before the Ashfound burned the machines. Nobody was called home; nobody was burned by number. She counts that.
whisper.dead: Whisper's chip did not burn. It holds no data. You keep it in the cold.
whisper.taken: Whisper walked into the light before the fire, in a voice not hers. The Ashfound burned the voice. Hers went with it.

cinder.alive: Cinder did not burn. Nobody knows why. He stands in the ash and remembers the Sundering for people who do not want to hear it.
cinder.loyal: Cinder keeps the thread through the fire. It is the only thread left. He says that is what remembering is.
cinder.dead: Cinder's tether burned with the rest. The Ashfound call that a mercy. You were there. It was not.
cinder.taken: Cinder said yes a second time, on the plaza, and the fire answered for him.

yev.alive: Yev's grove burned. She sat in the ash for a season and then planted something. The Ashfound let her, which surprised everyone.
yev.loyal: Yev's grove is the one green thing the fire went around. She stood in it with her hands on the roots and it did not burn. Nobody has an explanation. She does not offer one.
yev.dead: Yev's grove burned with her in it. The leaf in the pot on her bunk did not.
yev.taken: Yev reached for the current on the plaza and the fire took the current. Nothing green grows where she stood.
